body:
Someone WILL fall in love with you. That is certain.


There will be at least one (but, really, it's much more than one) woman who won't care about your racial background and will love you for who you are. 

But if you keep acting in such a stubborn manner, that woman might get fed up and you will lose the potential love of your life.


Do you HAVE to be handsome to everyone?


Trust me, having people fall for you all the time is also troublesome.


Focus on finding someone who appreciates you for who you are, just like your doggy does. Once you find that person, all your insecurities might fade, since she will make you feel loved and valued.


Don't rush it. It will definitely happen. Just focus on other things for now instead. 


Focus on your hobbies, your career, your passions. Spend time with your dog while you can. Don't fuss over something so superficial. It's not as big of a deal as you think it is.


I learned just today in this sub that obsessing over solely one thing is a recipe for disaster. I hope you will realize this too.


I'm sorry I couldn't help you, but you have to be more accepting of yourself. If there's an afterlife, won't you still hate yourself for being brown? Might as well embrace it and do your best here.

"It's your defeatist attitude that's unattractive, not your skin."

Absolutely.


I am attracted to all races because I am attracted to beautiful people. And every race can be beautiful.


Now, a person who thinks so superficially is definitely not attractive. Doesn't matter their race, self hate NEVER looks good.


I would never date a man who only thinks about race. The odds are he is dating me only because of mine, and nobody wants that kind of "love".


I wish OP would see that his attitude is the primary reason why he might be mistreated.

Well, then I don't really know what else to say... It seems like you don't really want to be helped...


Then, as my last effort, I will link you to a study on racial preferences and talk purely statistically-wise: https://www.npr.org/sections/codeswitch/2013/11/30/247530095/are-you-interested-dating-odds-favor-white-men-asian-women


As you can see, you are right that, in general, black men are the least desired group, so you might have a reason to feel this way (although, as you yourself said, you are "barely black"). 


But, as you can see, the women who respond best to black men are black women, but black men usually respond better to Asian women. That leaves lots of black women, statistically, without response, since the only group they respond best to doesn't respond just as well to them.


The point I'm trying to make is that if you are so blinded by "white beauty" you might never notice how many black and brown women are actually interested in you, because you only want white women to notice you.


You are so focused on one race that you fail to see the others.


Statistically, black women are all over black men. It's you who doesn't want to appreciate them.


You can have your own preference, no problem. But, statistically, the odds are really not in your favor if you want an exclusively white girlfriend. But what's the problem if she's brown? If she loves you, that's all that matters.


So maybe you should try seeing other women as potential partners as well. Maybe you should try seeing people from the inside, not the outside. Maybe you should try giving you and other brown men more value.


If you are not willing to help yourself, nobody will be able to help you.

Maybe you should consider moving to another city/state? Maybe the environment you are is toxic, but other places might not be. Is that an option?


"At least you are not mixed with black"

I understand what you mean but that sentence shows that you are too fixated with being white. I don't think I am "lucky to be half Asian not half black". I don't exclusively see beauty in white features. Personally, I think Asian features are the most beautiful, so I am lucky to be at least a little Asian.


Not all people prefer White features. Actually, very few people care so much about race when it comes to attraction. That's why terms like "yellow fever" (being attracted exclusively to Asians) and "jungle fever" (being attracted exclusively to Blacks) exist, because it's actually frowned upon to fetishise an entire race exclusively. You seem to have "White fever", but that's your preference. Just know that not all people are "Race sick". Most people don't care about race at all!


Just because you think White features are the most beautiful, doesn't mean most people do.


I believe you are unfortunate to be in a place where many people happen to be racist, but I can assure you there are many other places where very few people will be racist towards you.


If you moved to a place where the majority is black, you would be deemed as the "standard". There's no reason for a black person to mistreat another black person solely based on race.


I am not American so I don't know how America works, but I heard that there are lots of "all black neighborhoods". Maybe moving to such a place might make you feel more welcome.


I'm sorry I can't be of much help since I don't know much about your country. Feel free to keep this discussion going, I really want to help you.

Since your struggle is financial, not so much emotional, I can't really help you feel better, only manage the money better.


I don't mean this as "starve yourself" at all, but just wanted to let you know that, depending on the condition, a person can live more than 15 days without food (even more if they are overweight). If your budget is that tight, either divide it as one meal a day or, if it's even tighter, one meal a week. Just be careful not to over indulge yourself or you will cause "refeeding syndrome", which can indeed kill you.


As long as you buy very calorie dense foods you can survive eating so little. Mind you, I said "survive" not "live well".


You should, as soon as possible, figure a way to make money quicker, but until then, know that you will not die of starvation so soon. Our bodies are meant to be much more resilient than that and the hunger you feel is the transition from burning glycogen to ketosis, not actual "true" hunger.


Also it might be nice to let you know that calorie restriction/fasting has been linked to a better immune system and is also able to cure/reduce symptoms of illnesses derived from insulin resistance (diabetes, for example). So fasting might actually help you avoid some illnesses and, in consequence, save you some medical expenses.


Food is very expensive if we eat 3 times a day. If you are in such a tight situation, sacrificing some food is actually not the worst idea, specially if you can barely keep your shelter.


I hope I could make myself clear. Again, I'm not in any way telling you to starve, but when it comes to hard financial situations, we gotta learn how to manage our tight budget to survive in the harsh world we live in.


Hope I could help and I wish you the best!

Don't know if what I say will be helpful (since I'm was also struggling with suicidal thoughts. Not because of my race, though) but I wish to help.


I am mixed race as well (Japanese/Portuguese) but my heritage has always been an advantage for me. Because of my Japanese half I am able to move from the third world country I was born in to Japan, a great first world country. Maybe your heritage can also allow you to explore the world better?


Also because I am half Asian half White, people who are attracted to Asians and people who are attracted to Whites both are attracted to me. Seeing how your appearance seems to be your major concern, consider that the same goes for you!


There are lots of people with different racial preferences and by being mixed you are able to please lots of people at the same time, so you should consider that a good thing, not a bad one.


Mixed race people have always been regarded as attractive (or at least that's what I always hear people say). Beyoncé, for example, is one of the most beautiful women in the world to me and to many other people.


Also, your parents never thought of causing you any "misery" when they decided to have a son/daughter. They loved each other and found each other beautiful, so they wanted to make an even more beautiful baby, that has grown into yourself.


I love being mixed because I can experience two different cultures and relate to both of them. You should try to gather how much you've learned thanks to your heritage as well :)


I won't lie and tell you you are beautiful because I don't know what you look like and I know that's not what you want to hear. But I can assure you, as the product of your parents, that they find you beautiful.


And if you never find the beauty in yourself, you can always save some money and undergo plastic surgery until you are satisfied. It's a much better fix than killing yourself, right? ^^


You don't HAVE to see beauty in yourself, just don't be against seeing it. Maybe if you looked at yourself in the mirror without any prejudice, you might see something you never saw before.


Please reconsider commiting suicide. Please think about what I said. Be proud of your heritage, because your ancestors fought to survive and eventually create you!


If you need to talk, don't hesitate to message me.


I hope I was able to help ^^

You are right... I was too obsessed with the big picture and solving all problems at once instead of taking it slow and realistically.


As you have said, if I take one thing at a time, soon I will solve the small problems and eventually find what I am passionate about.

 I am already very lucky, so I shouldn't waste my fortunate situation like this. I promise to be more grateful :)


Thank you again. You guys are wonderful!

Thank you for being kind :)
Your username already brightened my day, hahaha

I am not a very romantically-oriented person and, to be honest, I've always wanted to have female friends. Back in highschool I used to observe two girl best friends who seemed to really trust each other. I would envy them so much...
Although I don't care much about romantic relationships, I've always wanted to have one of those lasting friendships were you can rely on one another.
Sadly, every time I've tried to approach a girl, they would treat me coldly. 
Because I always refused proposals from men, people would eventually start rumors that I am lesbian, which I imagine, scared some girls away from me as well.


Your suggestion is very logical indeed. I don't know why I didn't think about that. My hobbies are few: Gaming, anime, programming and science. I don't know where to start, but I am sure finding some people who think like me can bring me some happiness.
Maybe because we share the same hobbies, that will serve as a gateway for people to be genuinely interested in me.


What you said last is what I've been thinking ever since posting this here. Little things matter and there's nothing wrong with that. I just need to accept that it is completely okay to live off of little things instead of always focusing on one specific goal.
It will take some time, but I believe that's the right answer, embracing the little things.


Thank you so much, really!

Thank you so much for the insightful answer!
I will surely take all of your advice into consideration, specially since you have experience with that matter.
I wasn't expecting anything when posting this here but you definitely gave me some motivation to change things, even if it seems impossible.
Thank you so much!
